global_style.style_preamble: Editorial investigative product-film aesthetic. Dark graphite background (#2D2D2D). Clean modern sans-serif typography. Restrained, serious, trustworthy. No neon, no particle effects, no glowing AI brains, no stock-photo energy. Flat matte surfaces, soft directional lighting, subtle depth-of-field. Color accents only where specified. 16:9 aspect ratio, 1920x1080.

assets.subject: Abstract document / signal clutter
assets.prompt_body: Top-down view of an abstract digital investigator's desk on a dark graphite surface. Layered translucent document panels, PDF fragments, chat-window excerpts, entity lists with highlighted names, messy connection diagrams, and scattered reference cards - all in soft off-white and cool muted gray-blue tones. The fragments overlap and compete for attention, conveying information overload. No bright color accents - everything is desaturated and unsorted. The mood is pre-structure chaos: too much information, no system yet. Editorial documentary feel, layered paper-and-panel aesthetic but digital, like an investigative journalism desk reimagined as a flat digital collage. No people, no screens, no AI iconography.
assets.negative_prompt: Neon colors, glowing elements, stock-photo office, literal desk with coffee cup, any AI brain or neural network imagery, any text that is readable as real words (use abstract text blocks).

assets.subject: Founder silhouette / avatar
assets.prompt_body: Professional founder portrait composition on dark graphite background. A composed, understated male figure shown from chest up, centered or positioned in the left third. Neutral dark wardrobe (charcoal or navy). Simple framing with subtle soft directional light from the left. The background is clean graphite with very faint abstract geometric lines suggesting structure (not graphs, just subtle order). Leave generous empty space on the right side and top-right for text overlay areas - three credential lines and one principle statement. The overall feel is candid, anchored, professional - not heroic, not tech-visionary, not corporate headshot. Think documentary subject, not CEO portrait.
assets.negative_prompt: Heroic lighting, dramatic poses, tech-conference stage, bright backgrounds, smiling stock-photo energy, Silicon Valley aesthetic, any text or logos baked into the image.
notes: If using an actual photograph of the founder, generate only the background plate with this prompt and composite the photo onto it.
Leave the right-side overlay zone clear for three credential lines and one amber principle statement.

assets.subject: Document-to-graph transformation
assets.prompt_body: Wide split composition on dark graphite background. LEFT SIDE: scattered isolated document fragments in soft off-white - small panels implying records and references, but rendered only as blurred blocks, abstract glyph lines, or soft placeholder marks with no readable words or numbers, disconnected from each other, floating in disorder. RIGHT SIDE: the same entities reorganized as a clean connected graph network - circular nodes in off-white connected by muted teal lines forming a sparse, readable node-link structure. A subtle visual flow or directional gradient bridges left to right, suggesting transformation. Around the right-side graph, add a few tiny off-white abstract tag marks at the edges as non-readable graphic cues only, not literal words. The left side feels fragmented and lost; the right side feels connected and inspectable. Clean, conceptual, accessible - not a computer-science textbook diagram.
assets.negative_prompt: Dense academic graph visualizations, 3D renders, glowing nodes, particle effects, arrows with labels, overly technical notation, dark nodes on dark background (nodes must be visible), any readable text or numbers on the document cards, business-card layouts, crisp typed lines that look legible, category words around the graph.
notes: Document fragments must use illegible placeholder glyphs or soft blur, never readable names, dates, words, or numbers.
Edge tags around the graph must be non-readable marks only.

assets.subject: Pipeline diagram
assets.prompt_body: Horizontal pipeline diagram centered on dark graphite background. Five rectangular cards arranged left-to-right, connected by clean off-white directional arrows. Each card is a rounded rectangle in slate blue with off-white label text inside. Cards read: "Documents" -> "Neo4all" -> "Governed Graph" -> "G-Lap" -> "Investigation". The "Neo4all" card has a subtle warm amber accent line on its left edge. The "G-Lap" card has a subtle muted teal accent line on its left edge. Below the "Neo4all" card, a small subtitle: "Graph construction + governance". Below the "G-Lap" card: "Graph investigation + analysis". The whole pipeline reads as one continuous workflow, not two separate products. Clean architectural diagram style. Generous whitespace between cards. Professional system-architecture aesthetic.
assets.negative_prompt: 3D cards, drop shadows, gradient backgrounds, circular flow, disconnected product logos, feature-list bullets, decorative elements, any icons inside the cards.
notes: This asset intentionally references readable label text in the prompt. Treat that tension against the no-readable-text rule as a manual review concern.

assets.subject: Sample folder / case files
assets.prompt_body: Centered composition on dark graphite background. A digital folder container in slate blue, slightly open, showing edges of document thumbnails inside - file labels visible in off-white monospace text suggesting case-file names (use abstract placeholder text, not readable words). Around the folder, six case-theme label tags float in a loose orbit, each in muted teal with off-white text: "people", "companies", "relationships", "offshore meetings", "cross-border links", "kinship". The aesthetic is an organized investigation case-file folder - real and structured but not sterile. A small continuity note at the bottom in off-white: "Same dataset throughout". Clean, brief, functional visual.
assets.negative_prompt: Literal manila folders, paper textures, messy desk, stock-photo documents, any readable real text, bright colors, 3D renders.
notes: This asset intentionally references readable label text in the prompt. Treat that tension against the no-readable-text rule as a manual review concern.

assets.subject: Noisy extractions with red flags
assets.prompt_body: Dark graphite background. A layered pile of off-white document panels with overlaid extraction output fragments - some showing duplicated entity names, contradictory labels, missing-context indicators, and opaque output blocks. Scattered across the documents are soft crimson flag markers and warning indicators: small crimson triangles, crossed-out entries, question marks, and conflict highlights. The overall composition feels visually unsettled - this is a diagnostic scene showing what goes wrong when you extract without governance. The document pile is not chaotic-messy but systematically broken: structured enough to see the problems clearly. Muted color palette except for the crimson problem indicators. Evidence of the problem, not a scary illustration.
assets.negative_prompt: Literal red X marks, emoji-style warnings, bright red, cartoon error icons, happy/resolved elements, any suggestion that this is fixed, neon highlights, 3D elements.

assets.subject: Semantic chunking vs blind splitting
assets.prompt_body: Side-by-side comparison diagram on dark graphite background, split evenly left and right. LEFT SIDE (labeled "Blind splitting"): a document panel in off-white is cut by harsh horizontal lines at arbitrary points mid-sentence, with soft crimson dashed outlines around each fragment - context is visibly broken, relationships split across chunks. RIGHT SIDE (labeled "Semantic chunking"): the same document panel is divided at natural section breaks, with muted teal solid outlines around each chunk - context is preserved, relationships stay intact within chunks. The left side looks fragmented and lossy; the right side looks coherent and meaningful. Small annotation arrows below each side point to downstream quality indicators. Clean educational comparison - the difference should be visually immediate and obvious. Technical but accessible.
assets.negative_prompt: RAG architecture diagrams, code blocks, parser library logos, dense technical notation, 3D elements, flowcharts, any suggestion this is about a specific technology rather than a concept.
notes: This asset intentionally references readable label text in the prompt. Treat that tension against the no-readable-text rule as a manual review concern.

assets.subject: Bounded agentic workflow diagram
assets.prompt_body: Centered workflow architecture diagram on dark graphite background. Six component cards arranged in a top-down flow, connected by clean off-white directional arrows. Cards are rounded rectangles. TEAL-ACCENTED cards (AI components): "Orchestrator" at top, then "Evidence reviewer", "Evidence retriever", "Proposal preparer" in a row below it. AMBER-ACCENTED cards (deterministic/governance components): "Deterministic diff builder" and "Tools-only executor" at the bottom. Flow arrows connect top to bottom showing the progression. The ENTIRE workflow is enclosed in a prominent slate blue BOUNDARY FRAME - a visible rectangle with a label at the top: "Bounded agentic workflow". The boundary frame is the most important visual element - it enforces the concept of "bounded." Inside the frame: structured, systematic. Outside: nothing. Clean component-architecture diagram style. Each card is distinct and labeled clearly.
assets.negative_prompt: Free-flowing network diagrams, neural network aesthetics, circular flows, decorative AI imagery, unbounded layouts, glowing connections, 3D depth, any suggestion of autonomous or unconstrained behavior.
notes: This asset intentionally references readable label text in the prompt. Treat that tension against the no-readable-text rule as a manual review concern.

assets.subject: Before/after: chaos to governed graph
assets.prompt_body: Split composition on dark graphite background. LEFT SIDE ("Before"): a muted, desaturated pile of document fragments in low-contrast off-white and gray - visually flat, disordered, drained of energy. Represents unstructured chaos. RIGHT SIDE ("After"): a vibrant governed graph structure - clean nodes connected by muted teal lines forming a sparse readable network, with small warm amber accent markers at key governance points (suggesting schema validation, evidence links, curation checkpoints, audit trail). A subtle transformation bridge between the two sides - a gradient zone or directional visual flow suggesting the left became the right. The contrast between the two sides should feel earned and significant - not magic, but the result of a deliberate governed process. The right side is not flashy, just structured and trustworthy.
assets.negative_prompt: Magic wand or instant transformation imagery, glowing transition effects, before/after with dramatic lighting change, neon graph nodes, overly dense graph, celebratory or triumphant energy.

assets.subject: Canvas-first interface mock
assets.prompt_body: UI mockup composition on dark graphite background. A large CANVAS AREA occupies 75-80% of the frame - a slate blue workspace showing sparse graph nodes (off-white circles) connected by thin teal lines, with subtle grid or spatial structure suggesting an investigation workspace. Small graph control icons line the canvas edges. DOCKED TO THE RIGHT SIDE: a narrow COPILOT PANEL in muted teal, visually small and secondary - clearly a sidecar, not the center. The spatial hierarchy MUST make the canvas dramatically larger and more prominent than the Copilot. The canvas feels like the product; the AI panel feels like an optional tool. Workbench aesthetic - spatial, investigative, tool-oriented. Not a chat interface. Not AI-first.
assets.negative_prompt: Chat-first layouts, AI panel dominating the frame, chatbot UI, bright AI indicators, the Copilot being larger than 20% of the frame, centered chat input, any suggestion that AI is the primary interface.

assets.subject: Retrieval architecture routing diagram
assets.prompt_body: Centered routing architecture diagram on dark graphite background. At the top: a "Router" card in muted teal. Below it, two branching paths with directional arrows: LEFT branch to "Graph retrieval (read-only)" card in muted teal, RIGHT branch to "Document retrieval" card in muted teal. Both branches converge downward into a "Synthesizer" card in muted teal. Below the synthesizer, a dashed arrow leads to "Graph delta proposal" card with a warm amber accent (indicating user decision point - accept or discard). A small amber "Read-only guard" badge sits near the graph retrieval branch. The ENTIRE workflow is enclosed in a prominent slate blue BOUNDARY FRAME with a label. Routing arrows are clean and show the branching-and-merging logic clearly. The boundary frame enforces "bounded." Clean, systematic architecture diagram.
assets.negative_prompt: Unconstrained AI flow diagrams, neural network aesthetics, circular flows, decorative nodes, glowing paths, 3D depth, any suggestion of autonomous routing without boundaries.
notes: This asset intentionally references readable label text in the prompt. Treat that tension against the no-readable-text rule as a manual review concern.

assets.subject: Graph + document evidence side-by-side
assets.prompt_body: Split composition on dark graphite background, two equal panels side by side. LEFT PANEL (labeled "Graph evidence"): a small node-link graph excerpt with highlighted relationship paths in muted teal - a few nodes connected by emphasized edges showing a specific finding. RIGHT PANEL (labeled "Document evidence"): a document text excerpt panel in off-white showing a cited text chunk with a source reference label and highlighted passage in muted teal. Between the two panels: subtle off-white reinforcement arrows pointing both directions, with a small "reinforce" label. Both panels use the same muted teal accent - both sources of evidence have equal visual status. The composition communicates dual grounding: the answer is never without its basis visible. Investigative, evidence-forward aesthetic.
assets.negative_prompt: AI-generated answer without visible source, black-box response aesthetics, one panel dominating the other, decorative elements, bright colors beyond the specified teal, chatbot-style answer formatting.
notes: This asset intentionally references readable label text in the prompt. Treat that tension against the no-readable-text rule as a manual review concern.

assets.subject: Founder visual with product intercuts
assets.prompt_body: Return to founder composition - bookend with IMG-S02-A. Same composed, understated male figure on dark graphite background, similar framing (chest up, left-third or center). Behind or subtly overlaying the background: faint abstract highlights from both products - a few teal graph-node connections (G-Lap) and amber governance markers (Neo4all) as ghosted background elements, barely visible but present. The dominant text element zone is reserved for "Human always in the loop" in warm amber - the most prominent amber use in the entire deck. The founder is not triumphant or celebratory - resolute, candid, principled. The product highlights are subtle background texture, not competing with the founder or the principle statement. This is a closing image, not a victory lap.
assets.negative_prompt: Heroic poses, triumphant lighting, bright product screenshots behind the founder, celebratory energy, tech-visionary aesthetic, any text baked into the image (text will be added as slide overlay).
notes: If using the same actual photograph as IMG-S02-A, generate only the background plate with subtle product intercut elements and composite the photo onto it.

assets.subject: End card with contact area
assets.prompt_body: Minimal end card composition on dark graphite background. Center-upper area: a subtle slate blue rounded rectangle panel, completely empty inside, reserved for later contact overlay. Below it: a smaller secondary rounded rectangle, also completely empty inside, reserved for a later license note. Along the bottom: a clearly reserved full-width warm amber footer band or anchored baseline panel for a later principle statement, wide and intentional, with comfortable padding and absolutely no text, letters, numbers, icons, or pseudo-text baked into it. The overall layout is clean, spacious, and professional. Generous negative space. No decorative elements. The graphite background dominates. The amber footer is the only color accent and should feel deliberate, stable, and visually complete. This is not a hard-sell CTA - it is a quiet, confident, professional close. The footer is a background plate only, not a rendered caption.
assets.negative_prompt: Busy CTA buttons, social media icons, QR codes baked in, bright backgrounds, celebration graphics, confetti, any text baked into the image, logos, gradients, pseudo-text, placeholder words such as contact details or license note, a tiny amber tab or clipped accent at the bottom instead of a complete footer anchor.
notes: All overlay containers must remain empty background shapes only; no baked-in text or pseudo-text.
The amber principle area should read as a finished footer container, not a small accent block touching the frame edge.
